sections.title: Mini Game Stage
items: As you play through the Last Kingdom event, certain stages will initiate the For the King mini game.

sections.title: What's the For The King mini game?
items:
For The King is a tower defense mini game.
Build different types of towers to stop the Raptures' invasion.

sections.title: Tower Slot
items: Tap the tower slot to select the place to build the tower.

sections.title: Build Tower
items:
Tap the Tower button to select the tower you want to build.
Tap the button again to confirm your selection.
The tower is successfully built after confirming your selection.

sections.title: Tower Battle
items:
Tap the Start Wave button to start the game.
Once the wave begins, Rapture troops will appear.
The battle begins after they enter the tower's attack range.

sections.title: Nikke Slot
items:
Nikkes will participate in the battle.
When there are free Nikke slots,  you can select the tower slot to deploy a Nikke there.
You cannot deploy the same Nikke more than once.

sections.title: Deploy Nikke
items:
Spend gold to unlock Nikke slots.
The more Nikke slots you unlock, the more expensive the next Nikke slot becomes.

sections.title: Use Burst Skill
items:
You can use a Nikke's Burst Skill after deploying her.
Drag the deployed Nikke's slot to the spot where you want to use her Burst Skill.

sections.title: Burst Skill Cooldown
items:
Burst Skills have cooldown time.
The cooldown time continues even after you remove the Nikke.

sections.title: Tower Upgrade
items:
Select a built tower to upgrade it.
Upgrading towers can enhance their overall strength.
The maximum level of towers differs  according to the game progress.

sections.title: Tower Evolution
items:
Towers that have reached Lv. 3 can be evolved.
Evolved towers gain significant changes in their combat abilities.
The available evolution types will differ according to the game progress.

sections.title: Tower Skill
items:
Select an evolved tower to learn a tower skill.
You can use the tower's special ability after learning its skill.

sections.title: Tower Skill Type
items:
Tower skills are categorized into active skills and passive skills.
Active skills automatically take effect when the condition is met.
Passive skills are activated once they are learned.

sections.title: Tower Skill Upgrade
items:
Upgrade the learned tower skill to enhance it.
Tower skills can be upgraded up to Lv. 3.

sections.title: Upgrade
items:
Upgrade skills on the Upgrade page.
Upgrading skills can enhance the towers' basic abilities.

sections.title: Upgrade Point
items:
Broken Cores can be used for upgrading.
They can be obtained as first clear rewards of all stages in For The King.
